about: Each species' real Animal Power (species_behavior_principles, read 2026-11-20), sorted by hand into one visible survival mechanism (AnimalDex decision 420). Classified by Claude Code reading the Power text, no paid API. 'none': the Power is not a survival trait. 'doubtful': a judgement call flagged for review. 'look' (mimicry only): b bands, e eyespots, f feigning, t tint, with the mimicked colour.
